items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: And first Minetta was on the piano, then John Bean was on the drum. ... And I was playing the guitar then.

ctx.x: Ten years. Ten years. You played that quite a while. Yeah. The other night you mentioned the first time that Freddie Peppard came by and played with you. Was that at Parker's? Can you tell us about that again?

No, that was at the 101 Ranch. We only had string instruments there. And first Minetta was on the piano, then John Bean was on the drum. Old man Bean, Tarcum, on the drum. And I was playing the guitar then. Wasn't I playing? Yeah, I was playing the guitar then. And then we had the old man Willie O'Pri on the clarinet, sax. And we didn't have nothing. We had Jimmy Pala on the violin. Jimmy Pala. I got Jimmy for you. Yeah, you got Jimmy for you.

And then after, a little running come in. Yeah. Old man officer got a running and he had the boys, what they call him, he packs up his instrument. The gold's art. And you went behind and crossed the 25 and that was old John. That was George. That guy right.
